integrity_notes: The global theorem is proved analytically using a strict Schwarzian bound and the unique maximum of the fixed-point multiplier.
Numerical tests support, but do not establish, the infinite-parameter conclusions.
limitations: Only positive parameters p1,p2 and constant gamma>1; variable-opacity maps are excluded.
The thresholds are implicit; example values are floating-point approximations, not exact decimal certificates.
No independent priority or mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact re-entrant period-two window in a constant-opacity atmospheric map
